question: The owner's question, in his words: "Is time itself a fold like intelligence/life through DNA?" As read: under the cheapest laws that let parts meet, and then under the least law that keeps a made clock giving parts off, is there a pattern the growth makes that reads the clock at each return (its course differs when the clock is barred after a tick) and, more strongly, whose own knots number a fixed count for each of the clock's periods and stop within a stated lag once the clock is barred, under every registered numbering of the start?
inputs: The starts, taking rules, numberings, bounds, guard and limit named in the pre-registration and its data files; this study's definitions and claim; the definitions of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001 and the shared definitions of RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001; the engine of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001A and the code of the ring study, unchanged, as the gates' references only.
forbidden_inputs: Any definition changed after a value is seen; for the engine's author, the drafter's scratch prototype and anything it produced beyond what the pre-registration and compare.json disclose; any change to the frozen engines; any rule added so that a pattern counts, reads or returns.
primary_observable: For every registered run: every series of returns with its ticks, periods, parts given off and copies; for every registered test of a clock and a second part, the second part's own knots and joint knots in each period with the clock present and with it barred after its first, second and third tick, the masked run where they differ, the lag, and the verdict of the definitions for each of the two claims (holds, fails, undecided); for every case, whether it survives each registered numbering; the knot test of every knot under the run's own knot law.
comparators_or_controls: The control with no taking rule, which must reproduce the record; the clock barred after each of three ticks; the masked run; the second part barred; every numbering of a start of at most six distinctions, the shifts of the order of distinctions for a larger one and a registered list of 200 further numberings; the swaps of the fresh count, of when demand is taken, of the naming convention, of release for holding, of the ration and of the knot law.
resource_budget: 600 seconds of process time for each run and each test, each process under a memory cap; a run or test that reaches the limit is reported as unfinished, never as a negative. Anything expected to take over ten minutes goes through the shared runner with a row in the long-running index. Bounds: 18 rounds and the knot bounds and guard of the definitions.
first_executable_signal: The gates: the engine's rounds equal the frozen engine's knot for knot, the frozen run files are reproduced, and the sameness test accepts every renamed copy and rejects every altered one. Then whether any primary law keeps a clock that gives parts off at four ticks.
decision_rule: Each prediction is judged by its 'Fails when' entry; arguments, replications of the prototype and reported readings are marked as such. Each test has the verdict of the definitions; a law's verdict is 'found', 'none, every test decided', or 'none among n decided, m undecided', and the last is never reported as 'none'.
stop_rule: Stop when every primary law has a verdict on both claims with its reason; every law of the second arm has the same with its cost, and the least of them that keeps a clock giving parts off for four ticks while some part reads it at each of three returns is named, or none is among the decided; and every registered run is done and every prediction has a verdict.
nonclaims: An exploratory study of starts built by hand and of the ring study's census, to 18 rounds, under laws set by hand. A part whose course differs at each return reads the clock; it is not thereby a count of returns. A positive for the stronger claim would show one made part whose making follows another made pattern's ticks and leaves a count of them, under a supplied law, start, choice of take and round; it would not show that anything reads that count, that it counts ticks and not rounds (every period is measured in rounds, which are supplied; a conditional run separates the two), or any generality beyond its start and law. The owner's question is recorded as his and is an interpretation. No claim about physical time, physics, living things or minds.
